```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
  synchronize(): Promise<AgentAuthorityCapture>;
  isCurrent(capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined): boolean;
  /** Throws when `capture` is stale. */
  credentialFor(capture: AgentAuthorityCapture): AgentCredentialOffer;
  credentialOfferForHandshake(): AgentCredentialOffer;
  credentialOfferForReplacement(
    credential: AgentAuthorityCredentialInput,
  ): AgentCredentialReplacementOffer;
  synchronizeValidated(
    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,
  ): Promise<AgentAuthorityCapture>;
  bindHandshake(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture,
    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,
  ): AgentAuthorityCapture;
  /** Always throws: credential replacement requires server validation

  replaceCredential(): never;
  replaceCredentialValidated(
    expected: AgentAuthorityCapture,

    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,

  terminateValidatedCredential(

    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,
  ): AgentTerminalHandle | false;
  terminate(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,
    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,
  ): AgentTerminalHandle | false;
  /** The commit callback must be synchronous; it runs only while `capture`
   * is still current (and, under durable custody, while the durable record
   * still matches). */

    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,

    ) => T,
  ): Promise<{ committed: false } | { committed: true; value: T }>;
  /** Returns the unregister function. */
  registerParticipant(participant: AgentAuthorityParticipant): () => Promise<void>;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
  pause(): Promise<void>;
  resume(): Promise<void>;

   * synchronous; typed ownership, session, and network failures reject this
   * task. UI unmount code may ignore the returned task. */
  dispose(): Promise<void>;
  /** Drains the fresh-subscribe tail, pause release, and best-effort cleanup
   * tail. Does not await disposal; await dispose() for server retirement. */
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
  /** Writer-gated replacement; IndexedDB may defer until writer election. */
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
   * credential so headless consumers can read `auth: 'public'` operations
   * from a sessions server. Mutually exclusive with browser, agent, and
   * external-bearer custody. Auth-required operations receive the server's
   * ordinary anonymous refusal.
   */
  readonly custody?: 'anonymous-public' | null;
  readonly authClientProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authInvalidationProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authorityDescriptorProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authorizedLeaseProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly ephemeralAuthorityProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly ephemeralExpiryProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authCoordinator?: AuthCoordinator | null;
  readonly agentAuthority?: unknown;
  readonly senderConstrained?: boolean;
  readonly clientStoreId?: string;
  readonly authCounterCeiling?: number;
  readonly rqsStore?: unknown;
  /**
   * LLP 0043 M2 queued-intent outbox (LLP 0129 Phase 0). 'auto' (default)
   * queues connectivity-refused mutations durably when the resolved store
   * carries the outbox contract; false disables; true requires support.
   * A generated local-executable mutation composes with the durable outbox when
   * available and otherwise degrades to server-delegated online dispatch (LLP
   * 0155 local-read admission); explicit `queue: true` still requires the outbox.
   * A queued delivery resolves
   * `{ status: 'queued', clientMutationId, sequence, presentation }` instead of
   * a settlement; it settles by ordered replay after reconnect.
   */
  readonly offlineQueue?: 'auto' | boolean;
  /** LLP 0218 P4 relinquishment-event seam. When omitted, events land on
   * this client's LLP 0219 structured diagnostics channel; injecting an
   * observer redirects them (tests/tooling). */
  readonly devDiagnosticsChannel?: Readonly<{
    emit?(event: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): void;
  }> | null;
  /** Enable the default console reporter when (and only when) the shared
   * positive development-environment seam returns true. Defaults to true;
   * false detaches console reporting while preserving the structured channel. */
  readonly devDiagnosticsReporter?: boolean;
  /** Per-durable-head warning window for the queued/wedged dev condition. */
  readonly queuedMutationWedgeWarningMs?: number;
  readonly strictWireVersion?: boolean;
  readonly onWireVersionDiagnostic?: ((diagnostic: unknown) => void) | null;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
  /** Throws when `capture` is stale. */

  bindHandshake(

  replaceCredential(): never;
  replaceCredentialValidated(
    expected: AgentAuthorityCapture,

  terminateValidatedCredential(
    offer: AgentCredentialOffer,
    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,

  terminate(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,
    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,
  ): AgentTerminalHandle | false;
  /** The commit callback must be synchronous; it runs only while `capture`
   * is still current (and, under durable custody, while the durable record
   * still matches). */
  compareAndCommit<T>(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,
    commit: (
      context: AgentAuthorityCapture &
        Readonly<{ authorityDescriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor | null }>,
    ) => T,
  ): Promise<{ committed: false } | { committed: true; value: T }>;
  /** Returns the unregister function. */
  registerParticipant(participant: AgentAuthorityParticipant): () => Promise<void>;
}
```

## `SnapbackClientOptions`

Stable identity: `npm:@expo/snapback-client/online#SnapbackClientOptions`

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface SnapbackClientOptions {
  readonly adminToken?: string | null;
  readonly bearerToken?: string | null;
  /**
   * `'anonymous-public'` sends the auth-client protocol offer with no
   * credential so headless consumers can read `auth: 'public'` operations
   * from a sessions server. Mutually exclusive with browser, agent, and
   * external-bearer custody. Auth-required operations receive the server's
   * ordinary anonymous refusal.
   */
  readonly custody?: 'anonymous-public' | null;
  readonly authClientProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authInvalidationProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authorityDescriptorProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authorizedLeaseProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly ephemeralAuthorityProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly ephemeralExpiryProtocol?: number | null;
  readonly authCoordinator?: AuthCoordinator | null;
  readonly agentAuthority?: unknown;
  readonly senderConstrained?: boolean;
  readonly clientStoreId?: string;
  readonly authCounterCeiling?: number;
  readonly rqsStore?: unknown;
  /**
   * LLP 0043 M2 queued-intent outbox (LLP 0129 Phase 0). 'auto' (default)
   * queues connectivity-refused mutations durably when the resolved store
   * carries the outbox contract; false disables; true requires support.
   * A generated local-executable mutation composes with the durable outbox when
   * available and otherwise degrades to server-delegated online dispatch (LLP
   * 0155 local-read admission); explicit `queue: true` still requires the outbox.
   * A queued delivery resolves
   * `{ status: 'queued', clientMutationId, sequence, presentation }` instead of
   * a settlement; it settles by ordered replay after reconnect.
   */
  readonly offlineQueue?: 'auto' | boolean;
  /** LLP 0218 P4 relinquishment-event seam. When omitted, events land on
   * this client's LLP 0219 structured diagnostics channel; injecting an
   * observer redirects them (tests/tooling). */
  readonly devDiagnosticsChannel?: Readonly<{
    emit?(event: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): void;
  }> | null;
  /** Enable the default console reporter when (and only when) the shared
   * positive development-environment seam returns true. Defaults to true;
   * false detaches console reporting while preserving the structured channel. */
  readonly devDiagnosticsReporter?: boolean;
  /** Per-durable-head warning window for the queued/wedged dev condition. */
  readonly queuedMutationWedgeWarningMs?: number;
  readonly strictWireVersion?: boolean;
  readonly onWireVersionDiagnostic?: ((diagnostic: unknown) => void) | null;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface RqsResumeStore {
  isWriter(): boolean;
  whenLockSettled(): Promise<void>;
  /** Optional role-transition notification. File carriers without a native
   * watch primitive are polled only while pending work awaits writer custody. */
  subscribeWriterLock?(listener: (writer: boolean) => void): () => void;
  outboxEmpty(): Promise<boolean>;
  outboxRecords(): Promise<readonly Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>[]>;
  outboxMarkStranded(
    id: string,
    reason: string,
    predecessorPrincipalScope?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
  ): Promise<false | Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>;
  outboxReconcileCustody(
    principalScope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
    authorityDescriptor: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
    custody: Readonly<{ authorityEpoch: number; authorityKey: string }>,
  ): Promise<false | Readonly<{
    deleted: number;
    deletedIds: readonly string[];
    stranded: number;
    strandedIds: readonly string[];
  }>>;
  outboxDiscardStranded(
    ids: readonly string[],
    principalScope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  ): Promise<false | Readonly<{
    discarded: number;
    clientMutationIds: readonly string[];
  }>>;
  outboxMarkQuarantined?(
    id: string,
    refusal: Readonly<{ code: string }>,
  ): Promise<false | Readonly<{
    count: number;
    tombstones: readonly Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>[];
  }>>;
  outboxReenterQuarantined?(): Promise<false | Readonly<{
    count: number;
    clientMutationIds: readonly string[];
  }>>;
  outboxEnqueueWithOperationIdentity?(
    record: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
    authorityCohortKey: string,
    range?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
  ): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>;
  outboxAssignOperationIdentity?(
    id: string,
    authorityCohortKey: string,
    range?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
  ): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | false | null>;
  outboxOperationIdentityRange?(
    authorityCohortKey: string,
  ): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null>;
  /** Optional metadata slot used to prepare React bindings while offline. */
  loadReactBindingReceipt?(): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null>;
  /** Writer-gated replacement; IndexedDB may defer until writer election. */
  commitReactBindingReceipt?(
    receipt: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  ): Promise<boolean | 'deferred'>;
  readStoreMeta(): Promise<RqsStoreMetaV3>;
  writeStoreMeta(meta: RqsStoreMetaV3): Promise<boolean>;
  allocateQueryInstanceId(): Promise<number | null>;
  /** Internal v3 section seam. The callback must be synchronous. */
  materializationTransaction<T>(
    mode: 'readonly' | 'readwrite',
    operation: (view: RqsMaterializationTransactionView) => T,
  ): Promise<T>;
  /** Raw persisted record — callers MUST verify with
   * `verifyPersistedResumeEntry` before trusting it. */
  load(key: string): Promise<RqsPersistedResumeRecord | null>;
  commit(
    key: string,
    entry: Readonly<{ rows: readonly RqsRow[]; meta: RqsPersistedResumeMeta; token: string }>,
  ): Promise<RqsStoreCommitResult>;
  markInProgress(key: string): Promise<boolean>;
  markResumed(key: string, at?: number): Promise<boolean>;
  remove(key: string): Promise<boolean>;
  wipe(): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Clear resident/read projections for a session authority transition while
   * preserving the outbox for per-record descriptor reconciliation. */
  wipeForAuthorityTransition(): Promise<boolean>;
  resetCorruptStoreIdentity(): Promise<RqsStoreIdentityResetResult>;
  inspection(): Promise<RqsStoreInspection>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}
```

Injectable filesystem adapter (the Node default lazily loads `node:fs`;

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface RqsFilesAdapter {
  readonly powerLossDurable?: boolean;
  mkdir(path: string): Promise<void>;
  /** null when the file does not exist. */
  readFile(path: string): Promise<string | null>;
  writeFile(path: string, data: string): Promise<void>;
  /** false when the path already exists (`wx` semantics). */
  writeFileExclusive(path: string, data: string): Promise<boolean>;
  rename(from: string, to: string): Promise<void>;
  /** false when the path was already gone. */
  unlink(path: string): Promise<boolean>;
  readdir(path: string): Promise<readonly string[]>;
  /** Persist the directory entry created by rename before publication. */
  syncDirectory(path: string): Promise<void>;
  processId(): number;
  processAlive(pid: number): boolean;
}
```

Directory janitor for the shared default state directory: unlinks sibling
per-origin blobs (and their stale locks) that are provably abandoned —
never the caller's own identity, a live holder's blob, pending queued
intent, corrupt bytes, or anything younger than `maxAgeMs`. Availability
only; failures skip the candidate.

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
  readonly maxAgeMs?: number;
  readonly now?: () => number;
}): Promise<{ swept: number; kept: number }>;
```
